purpose: Suppress Edit/Delete affordances for the whole non-image informative-announcement family for non-admin viewers, while granting group-admin viewers a moderation-only Delete (never Edit), at the single canShowMessageActions chokepoint and its ChatBox.tsx call site.

public_api.name: isInformativeAnnouncement
public_api.description: True iff parseStructured(message.content) is non-null AND its type !== 'image'. Generic over any parseStructured result — the load-bearing family identifier (per S1/S4 convention: family membership anchors at parseStructured, not at render/testid).

public_api.name: canShowMessageActions
public_api.signature: (message: ChatMessage, currentUserPubkey: string, allowMessageActions?: boolean, isCurrentUserAdmin?: boolean) => boolean
public_api.description: Extended (backward-compatible, new optional 4th param defaulting to false) chokepoint gating both Edit and Delete render. For an informative-announcement message: returns isCurrentUserAdmin (ignoring authorship — ordinary members lose delete on their OWN announcements per the confirmed product decision). For any other message (plain text, or image): unchanged own-message-authorship check.

public_api.name: canEditMessage
public_api.description: UNCHANGED. Already returns false for any structured/non-plain-text message (pre-existing S6 behavior), so Edit is already suppressed for the whole family including for the admin carve-out — no code change needed here, verified by pre-existing + new tests.

owned_data: the 'is informative announcement' predicate (pure function, no persisted state)
dependencies_allowed: groups.tsx's existing adminPubkeys/isAdmin single-source-of-truth (prop-threaded through GroupChat.tsx -> ChatBox.tsx -> canShowMessageActions, same pattern already used for GroupMembersList's isCurrentUserAdmin prop at groups.tsx:813)
dependencies_forbidden: immutability-receive (messageEdits/api.ts, chatPersistence.ts) — this module does not import or duplicate the receive-side admin-check; each module independently derives admin status from the same source per architecture.md's boundary rules
